scope: Fixed unit circular generators in the existing native sector; universal algebraic finite-loop identities, exact recurrence and matrix fixtures, and operation-specific angle-lift records. Completion and all-angle arguments are written. No physical coupling or complete gravitational dynamics is selected.

loops.calibration_formula: K=chi(theta0,phi0)/(sin(theta0)^2 sin(phi0)^2)=1-mu^2 for a nonzero-sine reference and fixed unit directions.
loops.angular_area_correction: chi/A_ang^2=sinc(theta)^2 sinc(phi)^2; real completion and limiting proof are in THEOREM.md.

one_axis.recurrence: P0=1; P1=c; P_(n+1)=2 c P_n-P_(n-1); kappa_n=1-P_n(1-kappa).
one_axis.calibration: U(theta)=exp((theta/theta0)*L0), L0=theta0*A; theta0 != 0 and the generator increment/lift is retained.

winding.general_statement: For r=p/q in lowest terms, q>0, equal rescaled transports occur exactly when the winding difference is divisible by q. For irrational r they require equal winding. Written proof uses the inherited 2*pi kernel.
